name: @third-law/mcp-server
stderr:
Third Law MCP: using https://app.get3rd.com/api/mcp
Third Law MCP: (production). For local testing set MCP_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3000/api/mcp in Cursor mcp.json.
Error: MCP_API_KEY is required.

This server talks to the Third Law API (or your local platform). The API key identifies your account and is created in the Third Law app:
  • Production: https://app.get3rd.com/mcp → create a key
  • Local: http://localhost:3000 (your running platform) → create a key there

How to provide the key:
  • Using Cursor: put MCP_API_KEY in ~/.cursor/mcp.json under env (you don't need to run this script manually – Cursor starts it).
  • Running in terminal: set MCP_API_KEY in the .env file in this folder, or export MCP_API_KEY=your-key before running.
